Why Mooncrew

Most people fly in for Hilltop and lose half of it to cab queues, bad stays and groups that fall apart. We live here. We take twenty people, put them in one villa and handle everything else, so the only thing you do is dance.

The plan · 4–8 Feb

Five days, one rhythm.

Beach by day, Hilltop by night, the villa in between. Hover a day to see it.

Thu4 Feb Arrival + welcome party Airport pickup, villa check-in, welcome lunch and the pool. Sunset welcome house party. Want to start at Hilltop tonight? The car is ready. Welcome
Fri5 Feb Beach, then the hill A slow breakfast, Ashwem or Vagator beach, then Hilltop. Hilltop
Sat6 Feb The big night Brunch, a crew shoot with our photographer, then Hilltop's biggest night. Peak
Sun7 Feb Closing day + farewell The festival's last day, then a farewell dinner and house party at the villa. Farewell
Mon8 Feb Departure Breakfast, check-out and your airport drop. Home

House parties are sunset sessions, 5 to 10 pm, in line with Goa's music rules. Festival timings follow the official schedule.

What's included

You get to Goa. We handle the rest.

Not included: flights or trains to goa, food and drinks inside the festival, lunches after day one, shopping and personal spends, a private room (on request, at extra cost).

Our promise

Wild nights. Safe hands.

  • One of your hosts stays sober every night.
  • A female point of contact for every woman in the crew.
  • Crew vehicles only. Nobody rides back alone at 5 am.
  • Zero tolerance for drugs.
  • House parties with permission, ending at 10 pm as Goa's rules require.
  • Full terms in writing before you pay a rupee.

Anyone who loves psytrance or techno and wants Hilltop without the planning, the cab queues or the group chat chaos. First-timers are welcome. So are couples, friends and solo guests.

Yes, and plenty of people do. The crew meets in a WhatsApp group before the trip, and we match room partners. If you'd rather have a private room, ask us and we'll confirm availability and the extra cost.

In Anjuna, Vagator or Assagao, 10 to 15 minutes from Hilltop. We share the exact villa with confirmed guests.

No. Fly or take the train to Goa yourself. We pick you up from Mopa or Dabolim airport at set times on 4 February and drop you back on 8 February.

A 50% advance of ₹42,000 locks your seat, and the balance is due by 10 January. The trip runs once 12 guests confirm by 15 January; if it does not, your advance is refunded in full. Any applicable taxes are shown on your invoice before you pay.

Festivals in Goa can be stopped at short notice. If that happens, you get back whatever the organiser refunds for your pass, and the villa, food, house parties and the rest of the trip go ahead as planned. This is written into your terms.

Hilltop announces the line-up. We share it in the crew group the day it's out.

Call or WhatsApp Siddharth or Vinita, or send us a DM on Instagram. We reply personally, usually the same day.

No. We are independent hosts based in Goa. We buy your festival pass through the official channel and handle everything around it.
